versions.name: RXV2-0.9.249-wave-channels
versions.notes: The Bluetooth-ready wave is now configurable and universal: choose WHICH channels wave on the Output protocol page (e.g. 1,6 for a plane with two aileron servos; the throttle channel never waves), and the wave now fires EVERY time Bluetooth becomes available - power-on included - not just after switching the transmitter off. Also works on models with no captured failsafe. Installing this also updates the web pages.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.248-wave-fix
versions.notes: The aileron wave after switching off the transmitter now works on models with NO captured failsafe posture (it rides on the held servo positions instead) - previously it silently did nothing on such models. Includes everything from 0.9.247: update announcements and web-page delivery over Bluetooth at the field. Installing this also updates the web pages.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.247-field-updates
versions.notes: Field updates completed: with the phone app (iPhone 1.35 / Android 1.35), the home page now ANNOUNCES new firmware over Bluetooth at the field (the app fetches the release list with the phone's own internet) and one tap installs it - firmware AND web pages - over Bluetooth. Web pages now always ship with firmware even when installing from an older receiver page. Installing this also updates the web pages.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.246-ring-fix
versions.notes: Fixes the switch-off gap still showing (the trim ring was flooded by normal packets). Also skips the first seconds of battery sampling to kill a bogus 25V boot spike in the graph.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.245-field-ble
versions.notes: Field mode is now Bluetooth-only (no more auto AP when home WiFi is absent; AP still available in WiFi settings). Update page explains the Bluetooth app path instead of claiming updates are impossible. Current-flight view no longer shows the TX switch-off as a scary longest gap. Flight graph: missing sensors greyed out, battery noise no longer magnified. Aileron wave now repeats on every landing of a session.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.244-plane-blackbox
versions.notes: Blackbox now works on planes (no flight controller needed): flights record and save using the receiver's own battery divider. Adds radio swap count and per-transceiver time to flight stats. Includes the shutdown-gap trim and BLE aileron wave from 0.9.243.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.243-tidy-gaps-wave
versions.notes: Blackbox: TX switch-off no longer records a misleading final gap in saved flights. New: after the TX goes off, the receiver waves the ailerons when Bluetooth/WiFi become available.
